ability.name: AD CS Template and Vulnerability Audit
ability.description: Executes Certify.exe to detect misconfigured Certificate Templates (such as ESC1-ESC8) within the Active Directory domain.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\Windows\Temp\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { Certify.exe find /vulnerable } catch { "ERROR: $_" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d\adcs.txt

rationale: Satisfies the master requirement to audit AD CS certificates and potential template exposures.
